verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents entity-scoped memory that separates memories by user, agent, app, and session, which covers keeping memory private per entity. Scoping at the app level could plausibly allow memory to be shared across agents, but the evidence never states this, and the self-hosted per-user API keys address access rather than sharing. Missing for 10: explicit shared/team/group memory mechanism, documented way to share selected memories across agents or users, permission controls separating shared from private memory, independent corroboration.
